name: Campbell's Chunky New England Clam Chowder (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Packed with heavy dairy cream, pork lardons/bacon fat, clams, and high sodium. The heavy emulsion of dairy and pork grease triggers an aggressive gastrocolic reflex, leading to immediate urgency and loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active inflammation. Broth-based soups are far safer than cream-based chowders.
